[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/1043b0f71d76b7434b447d2cfd1ca45a7517801c.jpg[/img]

Hey folks!

notes.title: Hotfix to Major Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e73862f62b47cc6b8354f9c9939a535a1c26ad99.jpg[/img]

Hey folks!

This small hotfix is going to take care about a few bugs and minor flaws we missed in [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293460/view/7437182096122580656]the Major Update[/url][/b]. Here are the most important ones.

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/61e1abcce1d86a3e2bf98642afd7e3e93dc859f8.gif[/img]

First of all, we have found a small but pesky issue in upgrading your units with a special button. The thing is, if you had any upgraded cards in your hand and just wanted to upgrade the rest, this feature were changing the whole deck to default upgrades, the ones in the top. Now it is fixed, and you won't be unpleasantly surprised in the fight. Well, at least no more than usual :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/60423e44567da3953c5953ec3c00b0a7ae253bec.png[/img]

Another important win is the achievement 'Never laid a finger'. It was a pretty strange bug which we finally managed to beat (I truly hope so!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/9d0b06c07b325fa6e2724d177204049232795ee1.png[/img]
Next thing, we fixed an important bug in the duel for Free Game Mode. Death of an enemy unit caused by Stone of Rivers item were blocking the spot completely 'till the end of the fight. Now it should work correctly.

A few more minor things to mention are properly working 'End turn' button in the screenshot mode and slightly changed card looks when you get a deck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/ef0e2c1413f96be2628368441002deeabeff8ee9.png[/img]
That's pretty much it for today. We truly hope you'll have a great time with the game and your experience will be flawless.

Feel free to share any feedback with us on Steam forums or [b][url=http://discord.gg/ashofgods]via Discord[/url][/b]. And if you want to support us, please, leave an honest review. It will help us a lot. Thank you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/

Cheers,
A.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/7fe566f623e0d09d63970efb40cd05da03dc9dae.jpg[/img]

Hello friends!

Today, our game has finally received a huge update that we were thoroughly preparing for a month and a half. Essentially, it's a full-fledged DLC that adds a new game mode and a new deck, combined with another community patch. After all, throughout this time, we have not only worked on new content but also carefully studied your feedback. We hope that these innovations will significantly enhance your gaming experience.

Additionally, we have a few important announcements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/094dab2aa3517c18d6bc3867edb5e664e498b3c5.png[/img]

First of all, with the update we have added collectible cards to the game, which means you can now obtain badges, emojis, and profile backgrounds for the game. Last week we published [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293460/view/3674423070173941230]a detailed article where you can see all the available items that you can get[/url][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/87a2e40f76403a8d8e935c8eb496979df9f85217.jpg[/img]

Secondly, Ash of Gods: The Way now officially supports Steam Deck. We thoroughly tested the game on the console before its release, and it works perfectly in controller mode, despite the arguably small text size in some areas.

And finally, Ash of Gods: The Way is available again with a [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/ ]15% discount in celebration of the update[/url][/b], so there's no need to worry if you missed out on purchasing the game during the Summer Sale. You can get it right now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/ 
Now, let's move on to the changes. It might be a good idea to make a cup of tea because the list is quite impressive. We warned you!

[h1]NEW GAME MODE[/h1]

Some players have expressed their desire to continue playing after finishing the main story, and now they can do so in Free Game mode, which becomes available immediately after the credits.

For those who have already completed the game you simply need to load the latest save, skip the final dialogue, a cinematic and credits, and the new mode will be unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/c9a7056c1c1033171e859c85d9d72feeaf1cf6f1.png[/img]
What does it look like?

In this mode, you will have access to all tournament battles, including the champions, and you can attempt to complete them with a deck of your choice. However, it's worth mentioning that the difficulty of the battles will be significantly increased to match the level of the final tournament.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2bf76af371efdb9ea6132a7024ab65e48a48e116.png[/img]
This means that the opponents in the new mode not only receive stat boosts but also gain new abilities incorporated into their upgrade trees. For example, the Guardian gains Barrier and Regeneration, the Battle Sorcerer obtains Counterattack, and the Ranger deals additional damage to the enemy commander.

This approach is intended to significantly change the battle experience, as some old strategies may no longer work. It's also important to remember that not all battles in the game can be completed using the same deck, so don't forget to experiment and adapt to the circumstances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/c12ae64891b57d4424d83517cb3976310c7c0adf.png[/img]
In addition to that, in the new mode attempts are disabled, and all previous results are reset. If you missed any battles or forgot to claim rewards during the story campaign, you can still do so in Free Game mode.

The same applies to battle achievements, as long as you're not playing in Story Mode. Don’t forget that the difficulty level can always be adjusted directly in the game by accessing the Escape menu on the tournament screen.

However, the most significant addition to the Free Game mode is undoubtedly a new deck — the Enses deck.

[h1]ENSES DECK[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/ebcc4ffafb003043a847a46abc77b58423c93cf2.png[/img]
You have already seen this deck in the last tournament of the story campaign, but it was not possible to play it, as many of you requested.

The thing is, this deck was initially not intended for gameplay and was poorly developed, lacking sufficient synergy or unique features. We put a lot of effort into changing that, and as a result, the deck that players will receive is immensely different from the one present in the story campaign.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/037f28e6c0447b7e574128eb871b5f8ea1404c93.jpg[/img]

Firstly, we redesigned the icons of Enses to distinguish them easier from each other.

Enses also retain their original trait — they all have additional protection against ranged attacks. Additionally, they have received a speed boost, making them as mobile as the Berkanan or Bandit decks.
	
Another important feature of the new deck is the absence of unit upgrades. This means they don't gain new abilities nor have the same choices as other factions, but Enses are powerful enough to compensate for this.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oUwUtnC.gif[/img]

In exchange, they have another significant feature: Enses are versatile and can use support cards from ANY faction. Yes, you have read that correctly. Do you want to use poison of the Bandits, Berkanan counterattack, or Frisian armor? Enses can do all of that. That’s why their default support deck also includes cards from other factions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e41907cab2fd02b08177d68dfe85054b9aa20b40.jpg[/img]

When designing the game, we wanted each battle to have more than one possible approach, encouraging players to experiment with decks and discover combinations that surprise with their boldness and uniqueness. We hope that the versatility of the Enses deck will open up new opportunities for such experimentation.

It's also worth mentioning that this feature allows Enses to participate in Adjutant battles where a specific deck is required. Likewise, if a particular deck is prohibited in a battle, it doesn't apply to Enses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/4035f6bbbb5d5c850bb5fcec2933aaaa006e68a3.png[/img]

We spent a lot of time testing the new mode with various decks, including the Enses deck, and we sincerely hope that the current balance will satisfy the majority of players.

However, our team is very small, so as always, we would greatly appreciate your feedback, and we will strive to address any issues promptly if they arise. Please share your thoughts on the forum or [b][url=http://discord.gg/ashofgods]join our Discord channel to chat with us in real-time[/url][/b].

Also, we want to remind you once again that not all battles can be completed with any deck, and the difficulty level can always be adjusted during the game through the Escape menu on the tournament screen.

[h1]NEW DECK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/4218c9081151775e66566e8bde7620b432ac8842.gif[/img]

Since the game involves constant deck experimentation, deck management should be convenient and straightforward. Unfortunately, we couldn't fully implement this in the release version of the game. Now, we are excited to introduce a new system that we hope will significantly improve your gaming experience.

Firstly, we addressed the resource conflict issue. If previously you had to reset upgrades on cards to free up experience or gold required for improving other cards, now you can simply move unwanted cards to the deck. These cards will not consume resources, and all their upgrades will be preserved automatically, reactivating if you add them back to the active pool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/7feb83e16d7c4b161a394fbe986e5b31cb70bf3a.jpg[/img]

All upgrades are now displayed directly on the cards themselves. Instead of level numbers, you can see the upgrade tree and selected talents. This applies to both active and inactive cards. In the basic, unupgraded version of a card, this button is absent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/61e1abcce1d86a3e2bf98642afd7e3e93dc859f8.gif[/img]

The card upgrading process has also been significantly simplified. All cards in the active pool can be upgraded with a single click using a dedicated button. When using this option, the cards will automatically upgrade to their maximum level from left to right. If there is not enough experience or gold to automatically upgrade certain cards, the game will notify you and highlight the problematic areas. The same applies if there is an issue when changing the full deck in the editor or before a battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/65db45860a27856bc423f83fc1f24cd28532845c.jpg[/img]

This system works perfectly with support cards, but character cards have choices at the first and third levels. By default, the upper option is selected. However, we have taken this into account and made provisions for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3876f40109ec4ccf8197a20aa141fcc9ceba908a.gif[/img]

Now you don’t have to reset all the improvements to change the talents of characters and then click through all of them again. It’s enough to simply switch to the talent you need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/4641aaae78d04e8bf99c174988234989aaacc886.gif[/img]

We have also improved the handling of individual support cards. Instead of upgrading a card sequentially, you can directly choose the desired level by paying the required amount of gold with a single click.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/6c114fa7bae85c8c17471306738821973be0553e.jpg[/img]
The new system has also influenced the positions of the cards in the deck. Now all the cards in the deck are organized based on the following criteria in order of importance: faction / rarity / upgrades. This way all similar cards are placed together but do not group as one if they upgrades are different.

[h1]REPLAY THE TOURNAMENT[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a59cda0377c244271a635a44d42279cdaa14bb81.png[/img]
At your request, we have also added the ability to replay a tournament in case you are unhappy with your results or choices. This system works through special saves, so this option is only available to those who have started a new game or have not completed the current one.

How does it work? Once a player starts a new tournament, the game records their progress as a checkpoint that can be returned to at any time through the in-game menu by pressing Esc on the tournament screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/75327869c8e7e225cf652eca6506f783004b429a.png[/img]
This means that you can also return to any tournament, even if you are at the end of the game or in a new mode. For example, you can choose the first tournament while in the Free Game Mode if you want to replay the game, skipping the tutorial.

Keep in mind: when loading a checkpoint, you will lose progress in the current tournament. However, if you decide to go back several tournaments, you can return to the previously saved checkpoints of later tournaments until you overwrite them.

[h1]BATTLE CHANGES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/62eb35f290833b2015fcff9a9a80098076e895c6.gif[/img]

Here are a few more things we have changed based on your feedback.

Firstly, it's the battle against adjutant Eirinn in the third tournament. In this battle, where you have to use the Gellian deck, invisible traps posed special difficulties, nullifying any chosen tactics, which was particularly frustrating in the hard mode.

We agree that the battle was overly difficult and didn't bring joy in victory, as it felt random. Therefore, it has been completely reworked, and all the traps in the battle are now visible. We hope that this change will be helpful and we look forward to your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/df78abeb479c99696a205f1b9882b2e7446e6fe5.png[/img]
We also noticed that the adjutant Mirina’s qualification battle, in which you have to withstand a strong warrior capable of killing your commander in one blow, presents significant difficulties for some players, even in the qualification round of the classic mode.

Frankly speaking, we don't find this battle difficult. At this level, you can pass it without any particular tactics, simply pushing cannon fodder to the Punisher while the other warriors deal with the enemy commander.

However, we understand that some players need more time to learn the deck and understand the essence of the game in order to effectively solve the tasks. Therefore, we gave this challenging battle to the adjutant Mirina, making her pretty easy battle without commanders a simple qualification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/da0be8bbcde1adcca106f7a439940a349aa9d6ca.jpg[/img]
Of course, we didn't just swap them thoughtlessly. We also slightly redesigned the battlefields to remove the adjutant figure from one field and add it to another. We also changed the achievement texts associated with these battles and made sure they work correctly.

We really hope that the difficulty curve will now be even smoother, but we also want to remind you that you can play battles in the tournament in any order that suits you. Perhaps it's worth achieving a few more victories for new rewards that will help you overcome the battle that gives you a hard time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/4f3cebdbe68390519853e10b9533eaebddf2e96b.png[/img]
In addition to the mentioned changes, we also changed the battlefield a bit in another qualification for adjutant Mirina. There were also several bugs related to the disposal of killed units on captured checkpoints and in the duel as well as incorrect functionality of the Stone of Rivers in battles against two commanders. Everything was fixed.

We sincerely hope that you won't encounter any other bugs, but if you do, please let us know. We also want to remind you that the game now has a fail-safe against sudden errors: if your battle is stuck and nothing happens, simply wait for 30-40 seconds, and the game will forcibly end the turn to resolve the issue.

[h1]UI AND UX[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/729b2889fd1e0c880b952d2e13647eb1fdd92285.png[/img]

The next change is also made at your request. We have added the display of shields during the replay of battles, which is necessary to achieve the best tournament result. This will allow you to track your progress without having to go back to the main screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/d29a241b67ac25356d21b6299ab416fa6bd69d29.png[/img]
We have also added other shields. In some battles there are units with special armor that do not take damage until it is destroyed. We decided to highlight them to draw the player's attention. Now the icon for their armor is yellow instead of the classic blue. Additionally, we have fixed the incorrect highlighting for spells.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SphARDO.gif[/img]
We have also kept our promise to improve the display of options in dialogues. Now, when hovering over response choices, the windows scale based on the amount of text and do not cover characters' faces.

In addition to that, we have added more information to the description of the battle with the champion in the first tournament, allowing players to prepare for it better. Some players were unpleasantly surprised by the phases and the special unit with additional melee protection. Now, there will be no surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/0d7d9b11971d9552ffa151a2430b8e7394f686d1.png[/img]
This applies to tooltips as well. By default, they display the basic characteristics of each unit, allowing you to understand, for example, how severely wounded they are or how much damage is needed to destroy them if you break one of the items they have equipped. Unfortunately, this tooltip was not working correctly for enemies as it did not take into account the additional difficulty scaling and specific battle conditions. This has been fixed now.

Also, we have fixed the functionality of many achievements, ensuring that they all work correctly, as well as localization and voice acting in certain places.

Last but not least, the game is also available on GOG now if you prefer it there. We will update other platforms as well as soon as possible which are Nintendo Switch, Epic Games and VK.Play.

[h1]WHAT DIDN'T WE HAVE TIME FOR?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3fe374b2e2c51fb7a7f2b84fc5380e58993d0df1.png[/img]
Since the release, we planned to prepare builds for Linux and MacOS. While we made some progress with Linux, the lack of Mac devices within our team and the unsuccessful attempts to replace them with emulators significantly lowered the priority of this task. We will try to address this in the near future.

The same applies to adding «keyboard + mouse» mode for the Steam Deck. We don't have this device in our team, but we will also try to address this issue soon.

[h1]CONCLUSION[/h1]

Thank you very much for your support, and we sincerely hope that this update will bring you joy.

If you would like to support us, please leave an honest review of the game on Steam and [b][url=http://discord.gg/ashofgods]join our Discord channel[/url][/b]. You can also purchase the Deluxe version of the game or [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397200/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way__Coffee_for_Coding/]buy us coffee with the help of a special DLC[/url][/b]. Honestly, we could use some coffee!

Have a lovely week,
A.

notes.title: Update announcement and Steam badges
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/fdbb6c24a74dcb7c39cd33cd23a54cbcdbdbf720.jpg[/img]

Hello friends!

Great news — we’ve almost finished with the Major Update, and we’d like to officially announce that it will become available next Monday, July 17th.

The update will introduce a new game mode and a new unique deck, along with many other important changes that will significantly improve your gaming experience. 

But that’s not all the good news! Along with the update, you will be able to get collectible items — badges, backgrounds and emojis. So today we’ve decided to provide a detailed overview and show what you can get if you pick up all the trading cards.

[b][h3]Trading cards[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/4661be3d6fa6f188805f747d345de0d7dc28522f.jpg[/img]
There will be eight cards — you can get four of them automatically. They feature all main characters of the game.

[b][h3]Badges[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/094dab2aa3517c18d6bc3867edb5e664e498b3c5.png[/img]

When you collect all the eight cards, you’ll be able to get a level one badge — the Bandit faction standard. When you collect the cards again, you can upgrade them. You will gain access to Frisian, Gellian, Enses' and Berkanan standards.

The foil badge should be marked separately. By collecting special foil cards you can get a unique badge in the form of the game’s logo.

[b][h3]Emojis[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/8ea04413c2e4d9f518972e8ae1b4b11c6d13cf58.png[/img]

Apart from the badges you can also get one of the seven emojis: we’ve added four common, two uncommon and one rare one in the form of a red flag. It will surely get handy if you want to mark some important information in your guides or just warn your players and friends about any danger.

[b][h3]Backgrounds[/h3][/b]
And of course, one of the most interesting things are special backgrounds for your profiles. We’ve created some mockups to show you how your page will look like.

The first two are of common rarity. We’ve included the battle from the opening cinematic of the game and Gollah’s tavern here.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JBDAgLY.gif[/img]
Four uncommon backgrounds are for those who prefer to see characters of the game on their page.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iVPKlcO.gif[/img]
There are also two rare ones. We think the first one will be perfect for those who love card battlers. And speaking about the second one — we just like it!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TlFqdmF.gif[/img]
We’ve put a lot of effort into picking images that will decorate your profile. We hope you will find something to your liking! Please, tell us what you think about our collectibles in the comments — and look forward to the Major Update on Monday. 

You can also [url=https://discord.gg/ashofgods]join our Discord[/url] and share your feedback there, ask questions or simply chat. Join in!

A.

notes.title: UPCOMING CHANGES
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

We’re back from our vacation and are ready to continue improving Ash of Gods: The Way with renewed energy. So today we'd like to share some important changes including those you have requested. Let’s take a sneak peek at what we’ve accomplished so far. 

[h2]Free game mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/6d48b67697e111f304e5d00c8509a986e86cc455.png[/img]
When you complete the tournament in Wodan, the game ends, and to replay any fights you have to start from the beginning. In the upcoming update we want to provide you with the option to get back to the tournaments and start any fight (including battles against the Champions) with any deck you have.

There won’t be any attempt restrictions in the fights, and all the stars you've earned will be reset. The enemies’ cards will be upgraded to the highest level. Additionally, in these fights you can get rewards that you may have missed during your playthrough. as well as combat achievements.

But of course, the main highlight is the introduction of a new deck.

[h2]Enses' deck[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2d7434ce5d6aa42cf0367eecbd15925c0b3201b2.png[/img]
Many of you mentioned that they’d like to see additional content after completing the game. That’s why we’re adding a powerful deck that you could see in the final tournament in Wodan — the Enses' deck. With this deck, you can replay the game in free mode and try these mighty warriors in every fight across the four tournaments. 

The Enses' deck comes with unique features. Card upgrades are not available for them as they are already formidable, and they also possess some special abilities such as protection against ranged attacks. Instead, enses have an ability to use the support cards from any faction which offers a lot of opportunities for experimentation. We hope you’ll enjoy it!

[h2]New upgrade and deck management system[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/d3cc1419c9e09a33bbecd26093665a46bf938d8f.jpg[/img]
As the game revolves around constant experimentation and search for interesting tactics to solve combat puzzles, it’s crucial to have an easy and convenient way to interact with the deck. Our initial approach in the release version wasn’t perfect, so now we’re working on a new system that will enhance the deck management experience. 

First of all, we plan to improve cards' upgrade. Now when you remove a card from your hand, it becomes inactive, but retains its upgrades without consuming experience or gold — so you can use it for another card's improvement. When you add the card back to your hand, its upgrades become active again. However, if you don’t have enough resources, the game will notify you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/eac28335fe712782d890d111bf46b891e99a583b.png[/img]

We have also implemented a clearer indicator to track your upgrade level, replacing the previous text-based description. This allows you to easily see the current upgrade level and differentiate identical cards with different upgrades. They will also be kept separate in the deck. Basic, not upgraded cards won’t have such indicator.

[h2]Replay the tournaments[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/e945d779f08d1ed7e8d760cca1bbf171ddbdf5e0.png[/img]
Another feature that many of you have requested is the ability to replay the tournaments.

We plan to make this function available in the upcoming build providing you with more choices. With this option you’ll be able to get back to any of the tournaments you have completed. However, please, note — if you choose to do this you’ll lose your current progress.

[h2]Adjutant Eirinn[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/ed4067a134e08684849c086b42028bed1ff59fde.gif[/img]

We are carefully reading all of your feedback, that’s why we have changed the harder version of the fight against Adjutant Eirinn in Gollah, where the Gell deck is required. According to many players, the fight felt excessively hard and unpredictable due to powerful hidden traps that disrupted any strategies. We believe that the new version will address this issue.

[h2]UI improvement[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SphARDO.gif[/img]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1293460/announcements/detail/3708194993408428862]In the latest update[/url] we’ve taken your suggestion into account and added a display of Finn’s complete answers. We didn’t have enough time to finalize the visual aspect, but we’re going to improve this feature in the upcoming update. The window will look neater, no longer obstructing the characters’ faces and will adjust based on the size of displayed text.

[h2]Other improvements [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/eae05df4776ae03a54d6e0951e44ec7ff85f7f71.png[/img]
In addition, we have already fixed numerous small bugs, addressed a few localization issues and improved some visual effects. We hope it will improve your overall gaming experience!

Furthermore, we are planning to release builds for Mac and Linux.

The update will become available closer to mid-June, and for now we'll be happy to get your feedback on Steam and [url=https://discord.gg/ashofgods]in Discord[/url]. Thanks to your valuable input, we’ve already made a lot of significant improvements and are really grateful for sharing your experience with us.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/

[url=https://discord.gg/ashofgods]Join our  Discord channel[/url], we’re always eager to discuss your ideas or just have a casual chitchat. Thank you for your support.

A.

notes.title: Community Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey Challengers!

It’s been a week since the release, and we would like to thank all of you for reporting bugs and sharing your ideas with us. You’ve been a great help, and this update is based on your popular requests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/03f27420f7c40b38f0496ed3cfdab08bf2121842.png[/img]
For those, who just discovered the game, please, keep in mind, you are always welcome to share your feedback. We are carefully reading everything and doing our best to answer any questions you might have.

Also, if you face any issue, please, do not hesitate to contact us [url=https://discord.gg/ashofgods]via Discord[/url]. This way you can easily share some files to help us solve the problem ASAP. The folder you need is this one:

C:\Users\{USER NAME}\AppData\LocalLow\AurumDust LLC\Ash of Gods The Way

But let’s move to the changes we actually managed to deliver today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/0baed9fb3cc1acb5346e9041311c182f3c2889e3.png[/img]

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

The very first thing we wanted to improve is your experience with the story and dialogues. This is especially important in the third tournament because the consequences are based on the way you talk to the Chieftain.

From now on, you can see what Finn is actually going to say by hovering the cursor over the button. This way it will be much easier to choose what you actually want to say, especially when you talk to Hargell.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IkihvnO.gif[/img]

Later, we will do our best to make this window more neat but for now we just wanted to make sure that there is enough space for lines in German and French which are usually quite long.

Another important thing, Chieftain Hargell now reacts to your answers. This way you can easily understand if he likes or dislikes what you say, and can use that knowledge to understand the character.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pZPVmz7.gif[/img]

Keep in mind that Hargell may not react to some of your answers, which simply means that you failed to insult him or to earn his respect.

When that happens a lot or if you have mixed reactions, the Chieftain will more likely stay neutral towards you, and this will end the tournament in a certain way. But we actually reworked this part, and now you will get another option which some of you may find more attractive (and it has its benefits!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/36b868a68b218433daa49f78175476322172a502.png[/img]
That’s it with the big changes so far for the story and dialogue. Let’s move to gameplay.

There were a few cases when the game couldn’t transfer the turn and the only thing you could do is to surrender. We fixed everything we found but also added a simple workaround for those who might experience that issue again. Now, if the issue happens, the game should forcibly transfer the turn in 40 seconds.

We also fixed a few other critical things but if you managed to find anything to block your progress, please, contact us, we will fix your save in no time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3af12372d481449a453dd3a8d48643345819a37c.png[/img]
Other changes are relatively small. There are fixes for voice over and localizations and some changes for UI. For example, now you will see a proper tutorial window if you play with keyboard and mouse even if your controller is active.

And the last thing to mention is a lot of fixes for achievements. Now all of them should work as intended. Also, achievements shouldn’t spam anymore with constant notifications about progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/0d9b3e48ecbb5837ee96d82558cbc11603337449.png[/img]

[h1]WHAT’S NEXT?[/h1]

We aim to deliver the next update approximately at the end of the month. It will include a few important features that you, our community, requested.

First of all, we are working on a system to significantly improve your user experience with deck management. It will make constant deck changes and card upgrades less tiresome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/7e2edf541252f86c9a62dd38c0d661d411730078.jpg[/img]
Second, we are going to release some kind of New Game Plus kind of thing for those who would like to continue playing after the end. All the fights in the game will be unlocked and upgraded to the level of the last tournament, its conditions will be reset. This way you will be able to replay any fight with the deck of your choice — for example, try to beat the first tournament with a Gellian deck.

Last thing you asked us to add is the ability to replay a tournament for those who are not very fond of the outcome. We will do that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/f3d1816548b7fd2a970014d8856f866bc0ee8c97.png[/img]
If you have any other requests, feel free to share them in the comments. Meanwhile, we will take a week off to get some proper sleep because God knows we really haven’t for quite a while.

If you want to support us, please, leave an honest review about the game and spread the word. And once again, thank you very much for your feedback.

A.

notes.title: Ash of Gods: The Way – Full Release Update Changelog
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

Welcome to the changelog for the full release of Ash of Gods: The Way. Some of these changes were already mentioned previously, but it’s good to have everything in one place. Let’s get into it!

[h2]Gameplay changes[/h2]

All of the gameplay changes were made possible by your feedback on the Ash of Gods: The Way Prologue! It received an astounding 92% positive reviews, but there were still some places where improvements could be made. We already made plenty of changes previously based on your feedback, and we worked very hard to get these additional changes ready for today. A massive thank you to everyone who took the time to help us make the game better!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/65ea33febde5d21fc1c5d561b8bf1664396cfe24.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/65ea33febde5d21fc1c5d561b8bf1664396cfe24.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Restarting a battle[/h3]
It is now possible to restart the battle from the menu without having to surrender and head back to the tournament screen. This should make it a lot less painful when you mess up! This action may occasionally trigger a conversation about your loss, but if there’s nothing to discuss, the restart will be very smooth. Keep in mind that restarting a battle does count as a loss in battles where you can only afford to lose a certain amount of times.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2f87cf1c115e087c9f85a4c1e1a5288b664f6f77.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2f87cf1c115e087c9f85a4c1e1a5288b664f6f77.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Battle pacing[/h3]
We added the option to slow down the enemy’s turn to the menu. By default, all the enemy’s units will move in rapid succession, like your own units, but we got a lot of feedback from Prologue players that felt this was confusing. Especially in battles with a lot of units, it was easy to lose track of what was happening and your units would seemingly just disappear at times. When you toggle on the ‘Slow down enemy turn’ option, the time between unit actions is increased significantly, which should make it a lot easier to keep track of what moves the enemy is making. This does not affect your own units, as slowing down your own units’ movement would slow down the pace of the game too much.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/80c79af2a7ba50bf95613f88a6a87b83828509dc.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/80c79af2a7ba50bf95613f88a6a87b83828509dc.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Tutorial Additions[/h3]
We expanded the tutorial by including information about surrendering a battle and how this will be considered a defeat.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2e925d7ecbadd59ab8015e20ff3bd03acf79cb23.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2e925d7ecbadd59ab8015e20ff3bd03acf79cb23.jpg[/img][/url]

Additionally, we added information about camera movement. You can press and hold left mouse button (LMB) to move the camera, and the mouse wheel to zoom in and out. Be sure to have a look around the battlefields, there are a lot of pretty sights to be discovered!

Please note that if you have a controller or its dongle connected to your PC while using keyboard and mouse, the game may show you the tutorial for moving the camera with said controller. The rest of the game adapts to the device you’re using at the time however, so you can easily switch from keyboard and mouse to controller and vise versa.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/89e76cf1f42866ab6d8240ae26fc89bf4b4d79a2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/89e76cf1f42866ab6d8240ae26fc89bf4b4d79a2.jpg[/img][/url]

Additionally, the tutorial now includes a tool tip about the END TURN button and dialogue, which can now both be advanced using the spacebar. This should make it easier to play the game while eating a sandwich!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/5de967093a85c0d40861fef8b600144a16ca0368.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/5de967093a85c0d40861fef8b600144a16ca0368.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Interface changes[/h2]

Added a pop-up window explaining that combat achievements are unobtainable when playing in Story Mode.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/1c5297a7b78d4d3625c04e89f20971d0f2c74d17.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/1c5297a7b78d4d3625c04e89f20971d0f2c74d17.jpg[/img][/url]

Added some information about the game needing a restart to properly apply language settings.

Added a Master Volume slider to give you more control over the sounds in the game. Additionally, a Cinematics Volume slider has been added to adjust the sound of the cutscenes specifically. The volume is now equalized between cinematics and voice-over and a bunch of all-round improvements relating to the sounds of the game are also included.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/5b69543e96a56ef63d1daeeb5a463f55ef8359f2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/5b69543e96a56ef63d1daeeb5a463f55ef8359f2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Localization changes[/h2]

Thanks to the wonderful feedback from the Chinese community, we’ve made several changes to the font for Simplified Chinese localizations, which should make everything more legible and easier to read.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/07ed3b293adf1a5ebf0a3a03b4e593c22fe65f19.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/07ed3b293adf1a5ebf0a3a03b4e593c22fe65f19.png[/img][/url]

Expanded localization by including Ukrainian language text support. The game now supports English, French, German, Russian, Spanish (Spain), Simplified Chinese and, of course, Ukrainian. Various issues for localization for different languages have been fixed as well!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/c961ae9fedd95065eda182a388c8c15113da6641.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/c961ae9fedd95065eda182a388c8c15113da6641.jpg[/img][/url]

Keep the feedback on the localization coming! It’s all done by third parties and while we did our best to double check everything, we don’t speak every language. There’s no way for us to check if it’s all accurate, so all of your input is greatly appreciated. 

[h2]General Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made the main menu screen too bright (see below)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a battle against two commanders to freeze when the commander on the right is killed first
[*] Fixed a bug that caused an end-game battle in Wodan to freeze when destroying a wall in certain cases
[*] Fixed dialogue after losing a certain battle in a side quest of Rigga
[*] Fixed a blocker in Gollah
[*] Fixed a bug where a character who previously left the party would appear in the tournament
[*] Fixed the description of one of the Rigga qualification battles that lacked important information about the rules
[*] Fixed an issue with the borders of the sound setting sliders
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

For more information on the release of the game, head over the Ash of Gods: The Way Release Blog:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293460/view/3708194360591846502

For questions about the game, be sure to check out our FAQ:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1293460/view/3708194360591887277

If you find any additional issues or have some general feedback to share with us, please start a discussion in the Feedback & bugs subforum on Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/ashofgods]join our Discord[/url] to share your suggestions directly with the team!

notes.title: One week until Release – Changes & An Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello friends! 

We’ve officially reached the [b]final week[/b] before the release of Ash of Gods: The Way! As we’re working our as[i]h[/i]es off to get everything ready for release, we’d like to share some details on the final things we’re working on, from changes, the game to an exciting announcement!

[h2]Nintendo Switch Release[/h2]

Ash of Gods: The Way will be released for Nintendo Switch on April 27th and the pre-orders are now live! If you like to take your games on the go, you can grab the game on the Nintendo store. This is super exciting news for us as well, as we really do feel like the structure of Ash of Gods: The Way works really well with a portable console! Though you could also buy the game on Steam and play it on the Steam deck ;)

[h3]Watch the Nintendo Switch Gameplay Trailer:[/h3]

[previewyoutube=tY89BQRBs7c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Changes to the game[/h2]

We previously announced some [u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2304670/view/3713820137778511065]changes we wanted to make[/url][/u] based on your feedback on the Ash of Gods: Prologue. At the time it wasn’t quite sure what we could add in time before the release. Well, we’re very happy to announce that all these changes are implemented in the game upon release. The full changelog will be available on release day, but for now, let’s highlight a couple changes.


[h3]Restarting a battle[/h3]
We’ve added a button the the main menu to restart a battle, where previously only the Surrender button was available. This makes it a lot quicker and easier to restart a battle if you’re struggling. Previously, with the Surrender button you’d be sent back to the tournament screen and talk with some characters about your loss, but you gave us feedback on how this took too long. Now, with the addition of the Restart button, you will still have a talk with some characters after you restart a battle[b] if this is important to the story[/b]. However, if there’s no dialogue, you’ll be able to dive right back into the battle without exiting to the tournament screen.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2f87cf1c115e087c9f85a4c1e1a5288b664f6f77.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/2f87cf1c115e087c9f85a4c1e1a5288b664f6f77.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Battle pacing[/h3]
We also implemented a toggle to slow down the enemy movement during the end of a turn. Normally, all units on a team would move at once, attacking the target in front of them simultaneously. You let us know it was hard to keep track of what was going on and you were running into situations where you don’t know why you lost a unit. When you enable the ‘slow down enemy turn’ toggle in the menu, all the enemy’s units will move one after another instead of all at once. This should make it a lot easier to see what’s going on. Your own turn remains unaffected as to not slow down the game too much.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/80c79af2a7ba50bf95613f88a6a87b83828509dc.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/80c79af2a7ba50bf95613f88a6a87b83828509dc.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Language support[/h3]
We have expanded the accessibility of Ash of Gods: The Way by adding Ukrainian localization for interface and subtitles. The game now supports English, Russian, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Simplified Chinese in addition to Ukrainian. You can change the language in the Language and Sound menu, where we’ve now also included a message explaining that a restart of the game is required for a language change to apply.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/8c51ec642b185d2c281871eb24139bfe4e999e10.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/8c51ec642b185d2c281871eb24139bfe4e999e10.jpg[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Connect with us to stay up-to-date![/h3]

Twitter: https://twitter.com/AshOfGods

VK: https://vk.com/ash_of_gods

Discord: https://discord.gg/ashofgods

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC_Es3rxqdtXgpgQzJdbXGOw


Only seven days to go until the release. We hope you’ll join us on April 27th! In the meantime, we would really appreciate it if you could wishlist the game to support the release. It means a lot to us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/

[previewyoutube=CytheVNQXZs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Status Update & Demo Feedback
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/53e89ec30d16ee3d8a44c214916d6f0a44e0fb29.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/53e89ec30d16ee3d8a44c214916d6f0a44e0fb29.jpg[/img][/url]

Hello, friends.

We’ve been very, very busy working on The Way. We know there hasn’t been any news about the game for quite a while, but we’re about to change that. You’ll hear from us a lot more from now on, both here on Steam and on our other social media channels. Additionally, you’ll soon be able to play a new demo. Your feedback will be invaluable in finalizing the game for release!

We didn’t forget about our promise though! We still want to go over the finalized results of the last demo and the changes we made accordingly. So, without further ado, let’s dive right into it.


[h2][b]Overall[/b][/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/479b08f10f38b90eb6ab909551249b6cfebd55ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/479b08f10f38b90eb6ab909551249b6cfebd55ad.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/83ae6bf2f017b0bebd22496e7ba719e2408b8e36.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/83ae6bf2f017b0bebd22496e7ba719e2408b8e36.png[/img][/url]

Overall, we’re very happy with the feedback the demo got, especially considering the issues that were introduced in this demo. For starters, all new players were locked to story mode due to a bug. As this difficulty level was designed for people who are only interested in the story, it made the fights very easy and quick to complete. There was no real need for tactical gameplay, and a lot of people reported this issue in the feedback form. It should be fixed for the next demo!

Additionally, in an earlier demo of The Way, many felt we were too generous with the amount of gameplay it offered. Players could comfortably spend fourteen hours in the demo, which is a considerable portion of the game. We decided to shorten the demo based on this feedback, but missed the mark again. People reported they were speeding through the demo in a matter of hours, especially given the fact that the game was stuck in story mode for many. We made some more changes, so let us know whether or not this feels right with the upcoming new version.


[h2][b]Tutorial[/b][/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/977df153602d28eecf0cdbbea363b09bacbfdf5c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/977df153602d28eecf0cdbbea363b09bacbfdf5c.png[/img][/url]

As this game has quite a unique battle system, the tutorial is an important portion of the game to get right. We need to find a balance between explaining all the systems the player can interact with and the time it takes to get into the actual game. Some of the feedback indicated that the tutorial dragged on too much, so we decided to divide the tutorial into multiple stages. This will gradually introduce the player to new mechanics as they appear. The dialogue has also been shortened to get you into the fight quicker. We’re looking forward to seeing how all of you like the new tutorial!


[h2][b]Story[/b][/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/7ce84307f8dcd56e27857e0e00e1cca7e9bdbc38.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/7ce84307f8dcd56e27857e0e00e1cca7e9bdbc38.png[/img][/url]

The story of The Way was generally received positively, but reception is noticeably weaker than the overall feedback. Players feel the story of The Way isn’t up to par with Redemption. This is something we understand, but we’d also like to reiterate that The Way is intended to be a very different experience than Redemption. While the story took center stage in the latter, The Way is a lot more focused on gameplay and features a simple story to carry the player forwards. However, thanks to your feedback, we considerably changed the story’s design: we added more dialogue and branching paths based on your interactions with the characters you’ll meet on your journey. This will make the game a lot less linear and more tailored to who you are or want to be as a person.

Currently, each tournament in the game has its own story and several endings depending on how well you perform on the battlefield. The Way features many different endings; it’s about five times bigger than Redemption. Now, you won’t get to experience all this in the upcoming demo. The Way is still a gameplay-focused experience, and most of the early dialogue will focus on explaining the rules and gameplay mechanics. We did move some dialogue and story you’d previously experience later on in the game forward to make the demo more interesting. This way you’ll get a taste of things to come, but you’ll only truly get to know the setting and its people later on in the story.


[h2][b]Dialogue[/b][/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a453e33d0ee1514044aee14dbc2e3f2ed242373d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/a453e33d0ee1514044aee14dbc2e3f2ed242373d.png[/img][/url]

Regrettably, what we can do with the dialogue is limited by the simple yet inconvenient program we decided to use. This program was ideal for what we originally intended to do, but with the changes we made and the many branching paths we added, the limitations became very apparent. It’s simply not suited for the more complicated and extensive dialogue we’ve added since the last demo.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3f1610ebd3ac10eaadfa5def1c200e9fc1a13c48.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39509570/3f1610ebd3ac10eaadfa5def1c200e9fc1a13c48.png[/img][/url]

Nevertheless, we heard your feedback loud and clear and are committed to make the story the best it can be. You’ll have more meaningful and interesting interactions with the people you meet on your journey. Furthermore, there was a clear difference between how well the Russian and English dialogue was received. We are continuing our work to improve the English translation to get it up to par with the Russian version. Please, continue providing your feedback on this matter.

To conclude everything, we want to thank all of you for your feedback on our demos. It has truly been invaluable to us in the development of The Way. We would love to have you back for our next demo, so keep an eye out for our announcement on that soon! Look forward to a new main menu, story & dialogue improvements, (working) difficulty modes and more.

That’s all for now! Again, you’ll hear a lot more from us in the months to come. We’ll update you on when the new demo will be available to play. 

[h3]In the meantime, drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/ashofgods]Discord[/url] to discuss The Way and add the game to your wishlist! It really helps us out a ton.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293460/Ash_of_Gods_The_Way/

Thank you for your feedback, we’ll talk to you soon!
